messages:
Maya (CSM): Heads up — noticed a 48% drop in API calls for Harborline over the last 10 days. Advocate Sara is leaving next week and procurement just confirmed an NDA with RivalAI for a 30-day pilot. Can we triage renewal risk? :eyes:
Jamal (AE): When did the Rival pilot start? Scope? (embeddings vs generation)
Maya (CSM): Pilot kicked off last Thursday. Scope is embeddings + semantic search. Procurement emailed procurement@harborline and ownership is being handed to a new PM.
Ben (SE): Recommend we trigger the at-risk playbook: 1) quick ROI session tomorrow, 2) expedited technical QBR focused on cold-starts & batching, 3) propose a limited Dedicated trial with a cost cap. Who will reach out to procurement/executive sponsors?
Jamal (AE): I'll own outreach to CFO/CTO. Maya — you run the technical QBR. Ben, can you prep a cost comparison (our batching/cache wins vs RivalAI)? Tom, can you pull logs + token/latency breakdown for last 60 days?
Tom (RevOps): On it. Exporting token breakdown and latency trends now. Flag: procurement thread PR-3245. Will upload exports in ~10m.
OpsBot: Export PR-3245 ready: https://files.redwood.ai/exports/PR-3245-4109876543.csv
Maya (CSM): They said RivalAI impressed them with SKU-style billing and faster cold-starts. We should surface our batching + KV cache uplift and show concrete token savings. Ben — can you make a 1-slide "cold-start + cost" chart?
Ben (SE): Yes. Also propose a 60-day price-match trial for feature parity if they run both in parallel. Need AE/legal sign-off for the clause.
Jamal (AE): AE sign-off: agreed to pursue. I'll request legal for clause wording now. Maya — ping me if new PM pushes back.
Maya (CSM): Quick ask — anyone have a recent retail case that shows ~25% lower token cost after batching? Need a one-pager for the customer call tomorrow 11:00am PST.
Ben (SE): We have Aurelien Retail case study slide (sanitized). I'll pull and adapt.
Tom (RevOps): Files uploaded: https://files.redwood.ai/attachments/aurelien_cost_slide_v2.pdf and /shared/harborline_logs_60d.csv
Jamal (AE): Plan: Maya runs technical QBR + cost session tomorrow, I join for procurement questions. Ben prepares slides + delta numbers. Tom will attach logs to shared drive and raise support ticket to prioritize Dedicated trial ramp.
Maya (CSM): :thumbsup: I'll DM Sara to try to keep her as an internal advocate during transition. If she confirms exit, we escalate to Exec sponsor outreach.
OpsBot: Reminder: Renewal window for Harborline closes in 28 days. Recommended action: "At risk - proactive".
Ben (SE): I'll draft an outreach email and procurement appendix (cost delta + trial terms) and share in #cs-templates for review.
Maya (CSM): Thanks all — will update this thread after tomorrow's call and attach the QBR notes.
